# CI agents — Mike's Cookbook

This repo is part of the owner's weekly CI agent cycle. The **canonical
playbook** lives in MC Training:
[`4-Weeks-to-Open-/.github/ci-agents/README.md`](https://github.com/mcross2298/4-Weeks-to-Open-/blob/main/.github/ci-agents/README.md).
Read it first. Its "Repos in the cycle" section has the rules specific to
this repo. This repo's `CLAUDE.md` wins over both.

This folder holds only this repo's own decision log, `DECISIONS.md`. Agents
working here read it before proposing anything.

Agents covering this repo:
- Live QA (Wednesday)
- scout (Thursday)
- critic (Friday)
- builder (Monday)
- the Sunday digest
- the monthly retro

The field review does not cover it: there is no field-report pipeline here.
